question: Which observed handoffs make a five-session portfolio score an incomplete account of the committee's recommendation?
decision: Identify contracts to fix and regression cases to test before another registered forward comparison.
analysis_kind: Post-hoc descriptive analysis of unchanged election-replay-v1 outputs, discovered November 9, 2026.
membership: All 360 campaign executions: 60 stock/date cases, three treatments, two trials. No qualification runs, retracted prototypes, or new inference.

measurements.rating_change: Compare the Research Manager's Recommendation field with final rating on the same execution. Denominator: parseable committee pairs. This excludes the earlier bull/bear debate, prose changes and sizing changes.
measurements.conditional_wording: Regex in build_internals.py matches only after/if/on/above/upon, wait for, conditional on/increase, or subject to in final reports. Candidate for review, not a validated trade-entry condition or a failure label.
measurements.missing_horizon: Literal rendered Time Horizon field equal to not provided. Not a semantic audit of all time references. Single-analyst outputs use a different schema and mandate.
measurements.returns: Retain original five-session scores and original 10-bp-per-side sleeve P&L. Pending remains null. Do not simulate inferred conditional orders.
measurements.aggregation: Counts are executions, not independent market observations. No p-values, causal claims or estimated correction gain.

case_selection: Original weakest directional result; both research-to-final rating changes; strongest default-committee directional result; original seeded-random committee case. Selection and outcome known before review.
reviewer: Codex assistant; no human or financial-domain expert review claimed.
privacy: Export allowlisted flags, hashes and selected short model-output excerpts. Raw sources, prompts and complete traces stay in the private evidence project. Native drilldowns remain authenticated.
insights: Read the existing native Insights status and UI. No manufactured turns, paid judge, or clustering trigger. Separate native clustering from deterministic checks and assistant review.
reproduce: python articles/build_internals.py; private extraction adds --campaign lab-runs/election-v1/campaign
stop: Do not change trading prompts, original scores or published campaign denominators. Keep discovered cases in a development regression split.
